features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on analyzed data trends.
Users receive notifications for new recommendations.

features.title: Performance Trend Analysis
features.description: Create algorithms to analyze and identify performance trends in pipeline data.
acceptance_criteria: System identifies trends in pipeline execution metrics.
Trends are updated in real-time as new data is ingested.
Users can view historical trend data.

features.title: Visualization of Metrics
features.description: Generate visualizations for pipeline performance metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations are generated for key performance indicators.
Users can customize the visualization parameters.
Visualizations are interactive and easy to interpret.

features.title: Data Ingestion
features.description: Develop a module to load pipeline execution metrics into the system.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully ingested from various sources.
Ingestion process handles data in multiple formats.
System logs any ingestion errors for troubleshooting.

features.title: Stage Efficiency Assessment
features.description: Evaluate the efficiency of each stage in the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: System calculates efficiency metrics for each pipeline stage.
Efficiency metrics are displayed in a user-friendly format.
Users can compare efficiency across different stages.
